// Subsetted "Noto Sans" (regular + bold), Latin + Greek + common punctuation
// only — jsPDF's built-in fonts (Helvetica etc.) don't support Greek at
// all, silently rendering garbled symbols instead. This is what fixes
// that for exportPDF. Kept as its own module so it's only pulled into
// the bundle when a PDF export actually happens (dynamic import).
// Source: Google Fonts "Noto Sans" (OFL-1.1), instanced to static
// weights 400/700 and subsetted to U+0020-007E, U+0370-03FF, U+1F00-1FFF,
// U+2010-2027, U+00A0, U+00B7 via fonttools.
export const NOTO_SANS_REGULAR_BASE64 = "";
export const NOTO_SANS_BOLD_BASE64 = "";
